title: Tech Rout Sparks Volatility as PG Breakout Defies Market
speaker: Drew Nosek

macro_themes.view: Heavy selling in semis/AI names; SMH oversold at 50% fib and due for a technical bounce, tech worth buying at support.
Yield drop without gold/silver or stocks bouncing could be early signs of recession talk and hidden pressures.
Tanker attacks and war rhetoric keep oil supported and make investors reluctant to hold into the weekend.

notes: No date said; content (WDC/BE after-hours earnings, 'tomorrow' Friday, 'going into the weekend') implies recorded Thursday after close, likely 2026-10-22 — listing gives 2026-10-23.
